hero.title: Discord video size limit
hero.lead: A free Discord account can upload files up to 10 MB. Nitro Basic raises that to 50 MB and full Nitro to 500 MB. If Discord says your video is too big, it almost always means the free 10 MB cap — the 25 MB limit most guides still quote ended in September 2024.
qa.h2: Discord upload limits at a glance
qa.r3.v: No time limit — only the file size counts. A longer video simply has to be smaller per second, which is what the compressor below works out for you.
qa.after: The cap is on the file, not on the video's length or resolution, so the question is never "how long can a Discord video be" but "how much video fits in 10 MB". The table further down answers that from real output.
tool.lead: Drop the video below. It is compressed to just under 10 MB on your own device — nothing is uploaded — and checked so the result never lands over the limit. If the clip is too long to fit at a watchable quality, you'll be offered the opening stretch that does fit instead of a blurry mess.
fit.h2: How much video fits in 10 MB?
fit.lead: It depends on length: the same 10 MB is shared across every second of the clip, so a longer video gets a smaller picture. These rows are what this compressor actually produces from a typical phone recording — full HD, 30 frames a second, with sound.
fit.caption: What 10 MB gives you at different video lengths
fit.r1.q: Nearly full HD — hard to tell from the original
fit.r2.q: About half of full HD each way — still clear on a phone
fit.r3.q: Small picture — fine inside a chat window, soft on a laptop
fit.r4.q: Thumbnail-sized; watchable, but blocky when enlarged
fit.after: Past about 14 minutes, 10 MB stops being enough for a picture worth watching, and the compressor will offer to keep the first part of the video instead. For a longer clip at good quality, Nitro's 500 MB or a link is the honest answer — or the full compressor with a 50 MB target if the recipient has Nitro Basic.
over.h2: Over the limit? Your options, in order of effort
over.p1: Compress first: it is the only option that keeps the video playing inline in the chat, and for anything under a few minutes the picture stays perfectly good. If the video is long and quality matters, upload it somewhere else and paste the link — Discord embeds YouTube (an unlisted video works), Google Drive and most video hosts with a player. Nitro Basic and Nitro raise your own cap to 50 MB and 500 MB, but only for files you upload.
over.p2: Everything on this page runs locally in your browser — your video never leaves your device, so there is no upload wait and nothing stored anywhere. Not sure a clip will fit at a decent quality? The bitrate calculator tells you the resolution 10 MB supports for your video's exact length before you start.
faq.q1: Why does Discord say my file is too large when it's under 25 MB?
faq.a1: Because the free limit is 10 MB, not 25 MB. Discord lowered it in September 2024, and a great many guides, forum answers and even in-app screenshots still show the old number. Anything between 10 and 25 MB now needs compressing or a Nitro plan.
faq.q2: Does Nitro Basic raise the video size limit?
faq.a2: Yes — to 50 MB per file. Full Nitro raises it to 500 MB. The plan of the person uploading is what counts; recipients can download any size.
faq.q3: Is there a maximum video length on Discord?
faq.a3: No. Discord limits the file size only. A ten-minute video is fine if it is under 10 MB — it just has to be small on screen to get there, which the table above shows.
faq.q4: How do I send a video over 10 MB on Discord without Nitro?
faq.a4: Compress it to under 10 MB with the tool above — that keeps it playing inline. If the video is long and you need the quality, upload it to YouTube as an unlisted video or to Google Drive and share the link; Discord shows a player for both.
faq.q5: Is my video uploaded to a server when I compress it here?
faq.a5: No. The compression runs in your browser on your own device. There is no server involved, no account and no watermark — which is also why it is free and starts instantly.
